name: Mint
author: Izumi
description: Modelled on the AnimeKai site: a black canvas with a lime accent and a top bar. The featured banner keeps its filled progress bars at the start; section titles carry a lime bar and an arrow; posters have a soft radius with a score badge. The watch page docks the player above the server switcher and an episode number grid; the series page stacks info over a segmented control and a snapshot grid. Phones get a centred icon pill for navigation.
